# s246 — slicer must check and refresh file:line references in slice text

Slice specs cite code as `path:line` (for example `src/DataBall/DataBall.Open.cs:84`). After each landing the line numbers drift, so implementers and reviewers keep having to re-grep. In the DataBall relays, every brief had to say "line numbers moved after db-07". slicer should report stale references and offer to refresh them.

**Findings:** DataBall slice relays db-07 to db-10, owner 2026-10-10 · **Size:** M · **Trees:** src/slicer, tests, docs

**Not in this slice:** resolving references across repositories; editing anything other than slice sections and notes through the normal edit path.

## Why

slicer owns the slice text, and only its CLI may change it. A reference is checkable when the cited line still holds a symbol named next to it, for example "`OpenAsync` (`DataBall.Open.cs:60`)". When the symbol has moved, slicer can find its new line by search. A reference with no symbol nearby can only be reported, not fixed.

## Files

- `src/slicer`: a `slicer refs [ID...] [--json] [--fix]` command, read-only by default.
  - It finds `path:line` and `path:a-b` references in slice sections, resolved against the project root.
  - It reports each one: OK, missing file, out of range, or moved (the backticked symbol nearby now sits at a different line).
  - With `--fix`, it rewrites moved references through the normal edit path, so history and render stay consistent.
- `docs`: a command reference entry.
- `tests`: a fixture project and slice with OK, moved, missing and out-of-range references; `--fix` updates only the moved ones.
